Talia (Docs): Heads-up: Product asked for a focused migration note for v1->v2 (invoke -> generate). Request: one-page guide, three tiny snippets (cURL/JS/Python), and a brief support triage. Can we ship a draft by Wed?

Evan (API): Yep. Key differences: `model_id` -> `model`, `input` -> `messages` (array of role/content), streaming events use `delta` instead of `token`. We added a temporary header `X-Compat-Mode: v1` to opt into v1 behavior during the window.

Talia (Docs): Can you paste minimal before/after cURL and a very small shim? Want to keep examples <6 lines.

Evan (API): Old v1 cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model_id":"rwd-core","input":"Summarize this"}'
```
New v2 cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-core-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this"}]}'
```
Small JS shim (server-side):
```js
function legacyToV2(p){ if(p.model_id) return {model:p.model_id+'-2', messages:[{role:'user', content:p.input||''}]}; return p }
```

Maya (SE): For Dedicated/private customers add a short note: update any ingress/firewall rules for `/v2/*`. Recommend canary routing (10% -> 50% -> 100%). I'll drop an HAProxy snippet if you want.

Talia (Docs): Yes please add HAProxy snippet — will slot into "Dedicated customers" section. Also include a one-line perf note if the compat header is used. Evan, is there any perf impact?

Evan (API): Compat shim adds ~5-12ms per request in our bench. I'll mention that under "Performance impact".

Jordan (Support): For support triage I suggest three bullets: 1) If customer sees 410 on POST, ask if they use a pinned SDK or on-prem deployment; 2) Suggest temporary header `X-Compat-Mode: v1` as a stopgap; 3) Escalate if high-volume or streaming-dependent. I'll prepare canned replies once draft is up.

Talia (Docs): Adding a small troubleshooting curl to check headers/status: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Compat-Mode: v1" -d '{}'` — support can use to confirm compat is applied.

InfraBot: docs PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4012 (v1-to-v2-migration-draft)

Evan (API): I'll open the SDK changelog/compat sample PR and paste link here. Also note: streaming clients that rely on `token` field will need a tiny marshal change to read `delta` array entries. With the compat header we emit legacy-shaped stream objects.

Maya (SE): One more ops note: we'll keep a 307 redirect for GETs during Stage 2, but POSTs will require `X-Compat-Mode: v1` until hard-sunset. Add the staged timeline in the doc: Opt-in -> Redirect -> Sunset.

Talia (Docs): Timeline: draft by Wed morning, review by Thu EOD (eng/se/support/ops), publish Fri AM with soft in-app banner. If reviewers can comment on PR within 24h that helps.

Jordan (Support): Copy. I'll prepare canned messages and pager escalation steps.

Evan (API): PR link for SDK note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/88 — includes param rename examples.

Talia (Docs): Thanks all — merging after signoffs. I'll ping product for the announcement cadence. :thumbsup:
